Homepage_describtion.sub-topic: This is the website of the Resurrection Power Church in Paris, France.
Homepage_describtion.paragraph: Our church is a Pentecostal church founded on June 2, 2019. Our vision is to reveal the life and the resurrection power of Jesus Christ. Come and share the grace of God by attending our programs with us.
